name: Zoku Youjuu Senki -Suna no Mokushiroku-
original_name: 続妖獣戦記 －砂塵の黙示録－
source:
It is now the year 2048. You are the captain of Anti Strangebeast Special Police (A.S.S.P.) created to deal with the nuclear post-apocalypse gene outbreak. 
You've repelled the beasts from the Sophia police district, but the battle is long from end. Next A.S.S.P assignment is to destroy the beasts outside Sophia police district and to weaken them. The time of direct conflict has come.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-november-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
时间来到2048年。你是反异兽特警队（A.S.S.P.）的队长；这支部队是为应对核灾后爆发的基因异变而组建的。
你们已经将异兽赶出索菲亚警区，但战斗远未结束。A.S.S.P.接下来的任务，是消灭索菲亚警区之外的异兽并削弱其力量。正面冲突的时刻已经到来。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-november-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
